question: A man driving a car at a speed of 41 km/hr crosses a bridge in 2.4 minutes. Find the length of the bridge.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Directly convert the given time into hours and multiply by the speed to find the distance.

Distance = Speed × Time

Distance = 41 × (2.4 ÷ 60)

Distance = 41 × 0.04 = 1.64 km

**∴ The correct answer is 1.64 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Speed of the car = 41 km/hr

Time taken to cross the bridge = 2.4 minutes

**Formula Used:**

Distance = Speed × Time

 
 
 

 
 

 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
• 
 
• 
 
• 
 Distance = Length of Bridge
 
 Speed = 41 km/hr | Time = 2.4 min
 
 
• 

**Calculations:**

⇒ Convert the given time from minutes to hours to match the unit of speed.

⇒ Time in hours = 2.4 ÷ 60

⇒ Time = 24 ÷ 600 = 0.04 hours

⇒ Now apply the formula to find the distance:

⇒ Distance = 41 × 0.04

⇒ Distance = 1.64 km

**∴ The correct answer is 1.64 km.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Unit Conversions

To convert speed from km/hr to m/s, multiply the value by 5 ÷ 18. To convert from m/s to km/hr, multiply by 18 ÷ 5.

Average Speed

If equal distances are covered at two different speeds x and y, the Average Speed over the whole journey is (2 × x × y) ÷ (x + y).

Relative Speed

For two objects moving in opposite directions at speeds S₁ and S₂, Relative Speed = S₁ + S₂. If moving in the same direction, Relative Speed = S₁ − S₂.
